quests.title: Give the Road Some Fangs
quests.text: Gor Drazhak did not build a road through two front lines just to watch our wardens get buried beside it. Bring me two Scorch Venom from the Sinkmire Vipers by day in the {name:front_broken_causeway/reedmire}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/reedmire}. Our archers have volunteered to handle the arrows; funny how nobody volunteered for the snakes.

quests.title: Wear the Teeth This Time
quests.text: A recruit ought to wear a fang before a fang wears the recruit. Kill four Siegepack Hyenas by day in the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}, and bring me two Siegepack Fangs for the next recruits sent to the front.

quests.title: Bounty: Dead Weight Ashore
quests.text: The sea keeps dumping soldiers on Stormscale Summit, and the Last-Watch Mummies insist they are still fit for duty. Buy a boat from the Shipwright and sail to the island, then destroy eight by day on the {name:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore}, which lies {zone_area:front_stormscale_summit/wreck_shore}. Return for coin from the war chest. You can take the bounty again one hour after turn-in; the sea has plenty of reserves.

quests.title: Optional: Sink the Wages
quests.text: There is branded pay in the wreck at {name:r20_anchor_086} on Stormscale Summit, waiting for a salvage crew to call it wages. Take a boat from the Shipwright and give the wreck's pay to the sea before anyone accepts it. The sea already has the sailors; it can keep their money too.

objectives.label: Give the wreck's pay to the sea
